successors.name: British Colonial Empire
successors.text: Pate Island and the Lamu coast, which came under British protection after the German protectorate of Wituland was renounced on 1 July 1890

ledger.x: 1203: the Nabhani family re-found the sultanate of Pate.
January 1844: Said's army lands at Faza.
1895: the end of the Pate sultanate.

wars.name: Battle of Shela
wars.outcome: Failure: 'The attempt failed totally, and many were killed'; Pate, allied with the Mazrui of Mombasa, had tried to subject Lamu.

wars.name: Omani expedition against Siyu and Pate
wars.outcome: Pate and Siyu victorious: Said's force of about 2,000 withdrew from Siyu in 1844 and was beaten again in 1845; Siyu submitted to Zanzibar only in 1863.

certainty.note: An island town and its neighbours: no page gives a boundary.
